name: Cotton Linen Tapestry
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from durable cotton-linen blend fabric
    - Soft texture with lightweight yet sturdy construction
    - Hooks are fitted at two corners on the back side for easy hanging
    - High-quality single-sided printing with blank back side
    - Easy to fold, store, and reuse

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes:
    12 x 40 in ~ 30.48 x 101.6 cm
    15 x 50 in ~ 38.1 x 127 cm
    20 x 63 in ~ 50.8 x 160.02 cm
    24 x 75 in ~ 60.96 x 190.5 cm
    📌 Note: The Cotton Linen Tapestry shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customize only the printed design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
     - Designed with advanced sublimation technology to produce vibrant colors, detailed graphics, and long-lasting visual quality. 
    - The printing process helps preserve sharpness and color consistency for personalized and eye-catching designs.

 

  • Care Instructions:
    - Iron on low heat if needed
    - Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight to preserve print quality.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Perfect for parties, celebrations, weddings, birthdays, graduations, baby showers, business promotions, school events, storefront displays, trade shows, and home decorations.
    - Suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications. Comes with white rope hooks for convenient hanging and display.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for weddings, anniversaries, engagements, bridal showers, housewarmings, birthdays, Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, or holiday celebrations. Perfect for couples, newlyweds, family members, and friends who love meaningful decorative keepsakes.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-4 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 5 – 7 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Cotton Linen Tapestry

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 1-3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
